snippet.title: Toxic Harvest Teaser Announcement (Halloween Game)
snippet.description:
Trapped on Halloween night in a  chemical plant  after a catastrophic spill, you’re being hunted by something born of mutation and madness.

In this single player short horror, your only way out is blocked, but every time you push towards your escape, the screeching grind echoes, drawing the creature closer. Timing is everything, so listen for its movements, and if it sees you... Run.
Coming Nov 14
WISHLIST: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3999490/Toxic_Harvest/
